question: Does the predictive relationship between the locked baseline feature set and future equity returns differ materially between high and low interest-rate regimes at H-10?

procedure.step1: Split test data into HIGH and LOW rate regimes using locked definition
procedure.step2: Compute Spearman IC within each regime

statistical_test.p_value: Fraction of permutations with test statistic >= observed

confidence_interval.interpretation: If CI excludes 0.010, confirms meaningful regime difference
